description: This file manages the loading and registration of bundled plugins for the openclaw project, including plugin discovery, module resolution, and registry population.

methods.name: applyVitestCapabilityAliasOverrides
methods.description: Overrides plugin SDK capability aliases for Vitest testing environment.

methods.name: buildBundledCapabilityRuntimeConfig
methods.description: Builds runtime configuration for bundled capabilities with environment considerations.

methods.name: resolvePluginModuleExport
methods.description: Resolves plugin module exports to obtain plugin definitions and registration functions.

methods.name: createCapabilityPluginRecord
methods.description: Creates a plugin record object with specified parameters.

methods.name: recordCapabilityLoadError
methods.description: Logs and records an error encountered during plugin loading.

methods.name: loadBundledCapabilityRuntimeRegistry
methods.description: Loads and registers bundled plugins into a plugin registry, handling discovery, module loading, and error management.
